notes.title: I am currently working on the dialogue and tutorial tasks.
notes.notes:
The game has many features, and players might feel lost about where to start when they first enter. Therefore, guiding players to understand the functionalities is crucial. I was always planning to do this, but this feature is quite challenging and will take a significant amount of time to complete. The reason I’ve listed the game on the store early is to start building up wishlists.

Currently, the number of wishlists is still very low, with only 2,200+. I hope that players who are interested can ask their Steam friends to add the game to their wishlists as well. Whether they decide to buy it later or not, adding it to the wishlist now is a big help. Before the game’s release, the number of wishlists is very important for me, as it affects the game’s visibility on Steam.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046244/38f71d894265c0f35d97ac28691b1bd42dc81894.png[/img]

notes.title: I've resolved an embarrassing bug.
notes.notes:
Some people couldn't get into the game, and I found out there are also differences in how game configurations are read depending on the language system. This is the first time I've learned about this kind of issue.
Now I have fixed it. I'm very grateful to this friend, without whom I would never have discovered such a problem.
I hope that friends who play the demo version and encounter game issues can leave a message for me in the discussion area, so that I can discover and solve the problems.

notes.title: The Demo is available for download now.
notes.notes: If you enjoy the gameplay, please be sure to add it to your wishlist.

notes.title: You can communicate with me on the Steam discussion board.
notes.notes:
The game still lacks a lot of things. The purpose of the public demo is to accumulate players who want to buy the game as early as possible, and it can also be used to test the features.
There is still a long way to go before it goes on sale, and I definitely want to make it as good as possible before selling it.
If you think it's not bad, be sure to add it to your wishlist, it's very important.

I am an independent game developer from China, I hope that people from different cultures and countries can experience the game I've made. 
I rarely use foreign social media, so I am quite isolated from news and it is difficult to promote my games to players abroad.
